From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report request, interim attestation & secure delivery steps

Hi Sara / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about the Helio Health workflows and the compliance bar you need to meet for the pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security side: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: you asked for our most recent Type II. We can share a redacted copy and an interim attestation while procurement finishes paperwork.
2) Interim attestation (signed): we can produce a one-page interim attestation signed by our Head of InfoSec that covers the same reporting period.
3) Vendor DSQ: I attached a prefilled Vendor DSQ (Redwood_Vendor_DSQ.xlsx) — please confirm which sections you want us to expand on.
4) Secure delivery: we typically provide a pre-signed, time-limited S3 link for artifacts and a short checklist for ingest/procurement teams. If you prefer a shared Trust Portal link, we can provision that instead.

Requested info from your side to proceed:
- Preferred delivery mechanism (pre-signed S3 link OR Trust Portal)
- Who should be on the NDA/PO (procurement contact) — I saw procurement@heliohealth.com on the call, cc’ing is fine
- Any specific redaction rules (PII, customer names) you need us to follow for the redacted report

Next steps I propose: I’ll loop in our compliance lead and legal so we can get the copy of the report + interim attestation to you within 48 hours after you confirm delivery mechanism.

Attaching: Redwood_Vendor_DSQ.xlsx (prefill), SOC2_T2_forwarding_instructions.txt (delivery checklist).

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
